mentions.name: Ditto
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that copies favorite links — such as a LinkedIn profile, personal website, GitHub profile, and social media URLs — to the clipboard in a single click, built to streamline the job application workflow.
mentions.problem: When applying to job listings, it's inconvenient to go out and grab URLs for a LinkedIn profile, personal website, GitHub profile, social media, and other websites.
mentions.audience: Job seekers; free-to-use for anyone who wants it
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just launched Ditto, a copy-to-clipboard Chrome extension for your favorite links!

I've been applying to a bunch of job listings lately and it's always a bit of an inconvenience to go out and grab URLs for my LinkedIn profile, personal website, GitHub profile, social media, and other websites. I decided to build a solution that copies these links to your clipboard in just one click!
